## ✨ Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## 🎯 Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Who benefits from it?

**Example:**
> "As a clinical researcher, I want to upload DICOM files so that I can query radiology reports alongside text documents."

## 💡 Proposed Solution

How do you think this could be implemented? (Optional, but helpful!)

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## 📊 Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] 🔴 Critical — blocking my workflow
- [ ] 🟡 High — would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] 🟢 Nice to have — would be a good addition

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
